facts.fact: 篝火开场：陌生乐手奏乐，班卓男隔火对她调笑，Andra 眨眼回应
facts.anchor: The rhythm of music weaved through the crisp air, played by a couple of rowdy men Andra didn’t recognize.

facts.fact: Lydia 夜里扑进她怀里说靠她的魔法才能熬住不睡，还讲了追啄妈妈的公鸡的战果
facts.anchor: Lydia played with a wavy piece of Andra’s hair and whispered loudly, “It must be your magic!”

facts.fact: 共舞时她闭眼说看见魔法，Lucas 捧住她的头说"你就是魔法，别忘"
facts.anchor: Lucas grabbed the sides of her head, and Andra opened her eyes. “You are magic, you chicken shit. Don’t ever forget that.”

facts.fact: Lucas 的父亲、她的叔叔 Fergal 打破传统亲口讲百年前光女巫击败黑暗巫师的故事，Lucas 说他从没讲过
facts.anchor: “I’m Fergal”—her uncle placed a hand on his chest—

facts.fact: 世界观核心：光暗魔法共存靠平衡维持，破坏平衡者会被同类处死
facts.anchor: For millennia, light magic and dark magic coexisted. A balance formed between the two

facts.fact: 草药烟雾里 Andra 接收到世代相传的画面：煤黑眼睛的白肤男人把她从头到脚打量
facts.anchor: In her mental image, eyes darker than coal stared curiously at Andra, drinking her in from head-to-toe.

facts.fact: 她循树影跟进树林，黑兜帽猎人现身：金肤黑发、黑皮衣挂满刀剑，开口就是"小心，亲爱的"
facts.anchor: “Careful, love.” A velvety purr came from behind her.

facts.fact: 猎人下令"我要你跑"后倒数追逐，数到一时从树枝上落到她身后抓住她的腰
猎人自述全大陆最好的猎手，受雇处理本区域的东西："村里有个东西，我要它"
facts.anchor: “I’m the best hunter on this continent, and I’ve been requested to deal with something within this region.”

facts.fact: 他的怪物哲学：怪物未必尖牙利爪，也可能是美丽的脸与蜜语；吻手道别后消失，只留余烬与皮革气味
facts.anchor: “Sometimes, monsters are made of beautiful faces and sultry lies.”
